# Elizabeth Stewart

Elizabeth Stewart may refer to:
*Elizabeth Stewart, Countess of Crawford
*Elizabeth Stewart, Countess of Arran, Scottish aristocrat and political intriguer
*Elizabeth Stewart, 2nd Countess of Moray
*Elizabeth Stewart (daughter of Robert III) (1373 - 1411), Scottish princess
*Liz Stewart, American interior designer, actress and model
*Betsy Stewart, fictional character on As The World Turns
